name: REMOTE CONTROLS
text:
Infrared sauna is full of electrical devices, some of which can be controlled remotely. This is where a remote control could be of service. Operating a system such as infrared sauna from a distance is great. Saves a bit of time, but not essential. However, a remote control needs to be set up and this may take up a bit of time, but it is worth it in the end.

Amongst parts of the sauna that can be linked to the remote control is the audio system, lighting, chromotherapy.

If you want a replacement remote control or an upgrade of your system, or you need a set up - get in touch with us.

Would it not be better to press button on the remote control instead of manually turning on or off functions one at a time.

We’re looking forward to providing you with options to improve your sauna experience.
text_short: Remote control is a component of electrical device that operates this device wirelessly, by sending out radio or infrared signals. Remote controls allow you to operate sauna equipment distantly. You may set up your sauna devices, like audio system, chromotherapy, etc., simply and quickly. It is quite convenient, as this small device delivers you from the necessity of interrupting sauna session to make some adjustments to electronic sauna equipment work. Just press the button on the remote control instead of setting and changing equipment functions or switching sauna appliance on and off manually.
